# GeoRisk Engine

> GeoRisk Engine provides geospatial risk analysis and assessment tools.

This site is built as a single-page application.

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://georiskengine.com/blog/): Notes on climate risk quantification, carbon pricing, CBAM, and auditable emissions data.
- [CBAM'de Asıl Mesele Vergi Değil, Doğrulanabilirlik](https://georiskengine.com/blog/cbam-dogrulanabilir-karbon-verisi): Turkish-language post on the EU CBAM verification gap and why auditable emissions data is a competitive issue for exporters.
